runs.name: the cancel arrives before the first frame is read
runs.construction: the control message is written to the standard input before the run starts
runs.note: the command checks the cancellation at the frame boundary, so the run ends at once

runs.name: the cancel arrives 20 seconds into the run
runs.construction: the control message is written 20 seconds after the start
runs.note: the frames that were already in a stage without a cancellation checkpoint (the blind solve of the sources module, the point spread function and the measurement) finish that stage first; the run therefore ends with the frames' own outcome, not with exit 5

the checkpoints of the apps side: the command reads the frames (apps/cli/commands.cpp): the cancellation is checked before every frame
the workflow frame loop (src/workflows/normalize.cpp): the cancellation is checked before every frame
the geometry block loop (src/workflows/normalize.cpp): the cancellation is checked before every block
the export pixel loop (src/projection/export_projection.cpp): the cancellation is checked before every pixel
the stages without a checkpoint (not the: the blind solve (src/sources): the hypothesis search and the fit
the point spread function and the source measurement (src/sources)
the coaddition and the relative sky (src/stats)
